title: RISA: Recoverable Sparse Attention for Block-Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Block-wise diffusion language models (DLMs) refine multiple tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to token-by-token autoregressive decoding. Their long-context inference, however, remains bottlenecked by memory-bound attention: every denoising step repeatedly reads a growing historical key--value (KV) cache. Directly applying sparse attention does not fully solve this problem, because different queries can select different pages, inflating the block's collective read set, while repeated support construction adds overhead and permanent eviction can discard information needed later. We present RISA, a recoverable sparse-attention method with shared read plans for block-wise DLMs. RISA exploits the fact that historical KV remains fixed within a block while queries evolve across denoising steps. translated_title: RISA：面向块扩散语言模型的可恢复稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: 块状扩散语言模型通过并行细化多个token，为逐token的自回归解码提供了一种替代方案。然而，其长上下文推理仍然受制于内存瓶颈的注意力机制：每个去噪步骤都会重复读取不断增长的历史键值（KV）缓存。直接应用稀疏注意力并不能完全解决这一问题，因为不同的查询可能选择不同的页面，从而膨胀块的集体读取集合；同时，重复构建支持集会带来额外开销，而永久性淘汰则可能丢弃后续所需的信息。我们提出了RISA，一种面向块状扩散语言模型、具有共享读取计划的可恢复稀疏注意力方法。RISA利用了这样一个事实：历史KV在块内保持固定，而查询则随去噪步骤不断演化。新生成的历史被组织为精确优先层与恢复层；随后由种子查询构建一个受保护的、有界的读取计划，其……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出RISA方法，通过为块扩散语言模型设计带共享读取计划的可恢复稀疏注意力机制，解决长上下文推理中KV缓存读取带来的内存瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: RISA proposes a recoverable sparse-attention method with shared read plans for block-diffusion language models, addressing the memory-bound attention bottleneck in long-context inference caused by repeatedly reading the growing historical KV cache.
